summary: Legacy probe surcharge appears on finalized invoice after API key deactivation
description: Issue summary: BrightWrite reports a legacy 'probe surcharge' line item (monthly prorated) on their finalized invoice for March even though the API key used to generate the probe traffic was deactivated and the customer had no probe or health-check jobs running during the billing window. Impact: unexpected charge resulted in a negative provisional balance and a customer request for immediate credit and correction. Customer provided invoice PDF and list of deactivated keys for audit.
impact: Customer-facing invoice shows a non-zero legacy probe surcharge; affects customer's month-end reconciliation and triggers negative provisional balance on an account with dedicated commitment. Customer has paused autopay pending resolution.
steps_to_reproduce: Customer deactivated test/probe API key 'probe-legacy-kw' on 2026-02-24
Our billing pipeline finalized invoice for period 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28 on 2026-03-01
Invoice line includes 'legacy probe surcharge - prorated' for hours within the period after key deactivation
Postback logs show postback entries tagged with legacy_probe at timestamps after the key was deleted (unexpected)
Attempted re-run of reconciler for org returns same line item
logs: postback-reconciler: processed batch id 20260301-87fa; found postback fingerprint 7f3a which maps to org=brightwrite, key=probe-legacy-kw
metering-proxy: forwarded probe-tagged ping at 2026-02-25T03:21:10Z from edge proxy e-7 (edge timestamp preserved)
billing: invoice 2026-03-01-ORG-8472 line 12: legacy probe surcharge prorated 4.25 hours - $12.75
investigation_notes: 01 - Initial triage (Maya): Verified invoice and provided audit artifacts from customer including key deletion event and sample job timestamps.

02 - Correlation (Luca): Reconciler accepted postback fingerprints from archived edge proxies which retained 'legacy_probe' tag in header; fingerprint mapping still associated with the deleted API key in the postback cache for 7 days.

03 - Hypothesis: postback_reconciler is using a short-lived cache that maps postback fingerprints to API keys; when an API key is deleted, cache entries are marked but not evicted until TTL expiry. In cross-region failover, archived postbacks replay with old headers leading to double attribution to the deleted key.

04 - Evidence: Reconciler trace for fingerprint 7f3a shows cache lookup hit at 2026-02-25T03:21:10Z with a cache entry last refreshed on 2026-02-18. Key deletion event was marked but the cache eviction did not occur due to a bug in the key-deactivate consumer when the reconciler was under maintenance.
05 - Risk: Other orgs with recently-deleted keys may see similar residual charges until cache eviction is enforced or reconciler backfill is reprocessed.

06 - Temporary mitigation tested: manual eviction of fingerprint entries for BrightWrite removed the line item on a dry-run rerun of the reconciler but requires coordinated replay to fully clear posted invoice lines.
07 - Cross-team note: SRE scheduled an emergency reconciler restart to flush regional caches; change was applied to staging and then to us-east at 2026-03-12 02:30Z.

08 - Business impact: Because the invoice already finalized, finance will need to issue a credit memo or adjustment if reconciler replay confirms misattribution. Customer has asked for provisional credit immediately.
proposed_fix: Patch postback-reconciler to: 1) honor key deletion events by immediately evicting cache entries and 2) reject postbacks referencing deactivated keys during final billing windows. Backfill: re-run reconciler for affected window after cache eviction to correct invoice lines and generate credit memos as needed.
resolution_notes: 03/12/2026 - 02:30Z - SRE restarted reconciler in us-east to flush in-memory mapping caches (Luca).

03/12/2026 - 06:00Z - Reconciler dry-run for org BrightWrite reprocessed postbacks and no longer attributed probe pings to deleted key. Dry-run confirmed previous attribution comes from stale cache entries.
03/12/2026 - 10:15Z - Finance approved provisional credit of $12.75 pending final reconciler backfill results.
03/12/2026 - 18:40Z - Issued credit memo CM-2026-8472 for $12.75; customer notified and autopay hold lifted upon customer consent.
Follow-up: engineering to deploy patch to reconciler to evict cache on key-deletion events and add a reconciliation job to sweep last 14 days for deactivated keys. Target deploy: 2026-03-20
